_comment: LAB COPY of Alex for prompt testing only. No webhook, no phone number, never wired to n8n. Variables are hardcoded to the values the first live test call (call_4bfbca5c12d7f5e7f1f2ba04a6a) received. Promote a prompt to production Alex with: python tools/retell.py set-prompt llm_5cbc32e5872bbd9afb452c692071

post_call_analysis_data.name: outcome
post_call_analysis_data.description: How the call ended. booked = an inspection was booked. callback_requested = the lead asked to be called back at another time. not_interested = the lead declined. disqualified = the lead does not own the property or is otherwise not a fit. wrong_number = wrong person or number, or asked not to be called again. no_answer = nobody spoke. voicemail = reached voicemail.

post_call_analysis_data.name: callback_time
post_call_analysis_data.description: If the lead asked for a callback, the day and time they gave. Otherwise empty.

post_call_analysis_data.name: booked_slot
post_call_analysis_data.description: If an inspection was booked, the date and time. Otherwise empty.

post_call_analysis_data.name: notes
post_call_analysis_data.description: One or two short sentences: the lead's roof issue, timeline, and anything the team should know.
